title: feat: keep screen on, cap encoded gpu preview edge

commit.merge_subject: merge: feat: keep screen on, cap encoded gpu preview edge

description: MainActivity sets FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON (owner request): the screen stays on while the app is in front. The encoded GPU preview treats maxDim 0 (SOURCE_MAX_DIM, the paused full-res follow-up) as eligible and caps its long edge at 3840: an 8K pause used to fall to the CPU oracle and allocate 132 MB of ARGB (OutOfMemoryError on the 256 MB heap, twice per pause); after the change a paused 8K frame is developed on the GPU at 3840x2160 and the device log has no OutOfMemoryError. Export path unchanged (default maxDim -1 keeps the CPU door). JVM green.
